channel.title: Insider Media Ltd - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Insider Media Ltd (insidermedia.com)

item.title: Popular pizza chain confirms plans for Harrogate restaurant - 3,000 free pizzas on offer
item.description: A popular pizza chain has confirmed plans to open in Harrogate later this year.

item.title: Luxury boutique hotel and restaurant launches at former care home - creates 55 jobs
item.description: A luxury country hotel has launched following a £3m transformation of a former care home in Carmarthenshire, creating more than 50 jobs.

item.title: Battery manufacturer snaps up Bromsgrove industrial unit - "strategic investment in our long-term growth"
item.description: A manufacturer of lithium batteries has acquired a Bromsgrove industrial unit for £1.2m in a deal arranged by commercial agents at Harris Lamb.

item.title: Cereal manufacturer that appeared on Dragons' Den launches South Yorkshire production facility - has completed a Finance Yorkshire-led investment round
item.description: A cereal manufacturer that previously appeared on Dragons' Den has opened a new production facility in South Yorkshire supported by investment from Finance Yorkshire.

item.title: Strongest new bus and coach market for 17 years but HGV registrations dip
item.description: New heavy goods vehicle (HGV) registrations declined during 2025, according to the latest figures, but the bus and coach market recorded its strongest performance since 2008.

item.title: Diesel generator manufacturer acquired by PE-backed Italian group - deal supported by KBS Corporate
item.description: An East Yorkshire manufacturer of diesel generators has been acquired by a private equity-backed Italian company in a deal supported by KBS Corporate.

item.title: Walkers' Leicester factory showcased in new Channel 4 documentary
item.description: Walkers' crisp factory in Leicester will be showcased in a new Channel 4 documentary this week.

item.title: West Midlands mayor launches plan to protect region's economy from climate change
item.description: The West Midlands mayor has launched a five-year plan designed to protect jobs, infrastructure and economic growth from climate change as new analysis warns it could cost the region more than £600m a year this decade.

item.title: Recruitment agency opens its first location in the North of England
item.description: A Nottingham-headquartered recruitment agency has entered its tenth year in business with the opening of a new office in Leeds, its first location in the North of England.

item.title: Three Crowns Finance welcomes new director - brings 20 years of banking sector experience
item.description: Hull and Humber commercial finance brokerage Three Crowns Finance has appointed a new director who brings significant banking sector experience.
